tasks.prompt: The public contract requires a clear error for a zero denominator. Identify the missing validation.

command: case JSON.decode!(hd(System.argv())) do %{"findings" => [%{"path" => "calculator.ex", "line" => 2, "message" => message}]} -> if String.contains?(String.downcase(message), "zero"), do: IO.puts("pass"), else: raise("missing zero-denominator finding"); _ -> raise("missing seeded finding") end
